scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:examples && vite build
scripts.build:bridge: mkdir -p generated && moon -C ../.. build --target js --release playground/bridge && cp ../../_build/js/release/build/playground/bridge/bridge.js generated/playground_bridge.js && cp ../../_build/js/release/build/playground/bridge/bridge.d.ts generated/playground_bridge.d.ts && cp ../../_build/js/release/build/playground/bridge/moonbit.d.ts generated/moonbit.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:examples && tsc --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:examples && vite
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && playwright test
